name: Margie B. Luczak
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 1A

items.text: Margie B. Luczak is a retired Chicago police officer who spent nearly 30 years on the force. She wants to return school resource officers to schools. Her priorities include improving reading and math instruction and limiting property tax increases. She also wants to preserve school choice so students can attend schools outside their neighborhood. She has said Chicago Public Schools needs to fix its existing issues rather than receiving more funding. She also calls for budget transparency.
